question_text: A delivery robot uses a trained neural-network detector to locate objects in multiple camera frames and output 3D boxes. It must react quickly even when its network connection fails. Evaluate the processing and memory hardware needed, considering an onboard GPU and a remote cloud service.
adaptation_rationale: Make ML deployment explicit; evaluate detector workload, not the inexpensive box geometry alone. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
